reviews.title: Hp omnibook x 14inch 2 - inch- 1 laptop, 1TB
reviews.body:
Amazing and comes with a pen. I was so happy to see the pen and the pen writing is smooth too. The pens magnets holds firm to the omnibook.

The laptop is pretty fast and the screen doesn’t wobble. It’s not as light as a 13inch Mac book but I don’t feel it when I carry it in my bag.

It’s very fast.
reviews.excerpt: It’s not as light as a 13inch Mac book but I don’t feel it when I carry it in my bag.

reviews.title: A ho hum PC. DIFFICULT TO ADJUST TO
reviews.body: Have been a PC user and a MacBook user. This pc has been difficult to adjust to. Not very intuitive. Use it for routine office type jobs but performance is lackluster

reviews.title: Ok Machine
reviews.body:
Good: For the price point> 32 GB ram, Strong processor, Convertible
Bad: Display still lagging behind (my 8 yrs old Surface book has much sharper display. Alos, Grainy if you see it closely. Not so bright as well, Not enough ports, Heavy.
Overall: Researched heavily, Didn't find any other machine
